description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkModeManager component, specifically testing its error handling related to PCM format rejection and playback failure scenarios.

classes.name: TalkModeManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite for the TalkModeManager, containing tests to verify error handling behaviors.

methods.name: detectsPCMFormatRejectionFromElevenLabsError
methods.description: Test method that creates an NSError simulating an ElevenLabs API error with a 403 code and checks if the PCM format rejection is correctly identified.

methods.name: ignoresGenericPlaybackFailuresForPCMFormatRejection
methods.description: Test method that creates a generic NSError related to playback failure and asserts that it is not falsely identified as a PCM format rejection.
